## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix refresh before merge because it can erase the fingerprint that verification needs to detect a hand-edited tracked file.

## Changes

The pull request adds two helpers that update the integrity manifest, along with tests for registration and verification.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints during refresh — If you refresh an edited `tracked.txt` alongside `new.txt`, the unconditional assignment replaces the saved digest for `tracked.txt` with the digest of its edited contents. — If the other files match their recorded fingerprints, verification reports success despite the hand edit. — Fix: Reuse `register_new_files` in the refresh helper and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` to cover an edited tracked file.
